dedupe_keys.name: psi collect post storm imagery collector

description: psi-collect is a Python module for locating and retrieving United States post-storm aerial images from the NOAA Emergency Response Imagery archive. It selects images by storm, acquisition date, image type or filename pattern, supports interrupted-download resumption, checks archive integrity and writes a CSV image catalogue. Its geographic and temporal coverage follow the NOAA storm flights requested by the user; the package does not create aerial observations. The public repository and Python package documentation are MIT licensed. Metadata from the selected images can support assessment of coastal infrastructure damage and help compare storm-simulation outputs with observed post-event conditions. A caveat is that flight footprints, image quality and acquisition times vary by storm. The software fetches large TAR or ZIP archives during normal use, but this review did not download any imagery or archive. No directly related catalogue or first-review software record was established. The JOSS paper, own repository and README were read without running the module.
